title: Endpoints Were Inside You All Along
missionBriefing: api-svc exists and its backend Pods are healthy, but the Service has no usable backends. Restore routing without recreating the Deployment or Service.
successCriteria: api-svc selects the intended backend Pods.
Its EndpointSlice contains two ready endpoints.
The Service remains ClusterIP on port 80.
hints: Trace Service to EndpointSlice to Pod; compare selectors with labels exactly.
The backend Pods carry app=mission-api. Make the existing Service select it.
